subject: MAP & evaluation cadence for Edge Health reserved capacity
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.r@edgehealth.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP & eval cadence for Edge Health reserve plan

Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput and latency numbers looked promising for our clinical inference pipeline. We want to formalize a short Mutual Action Plan so we can sign up for reserved capacity (Private deployment) and align evaluation gates. High level asks from our side: 

- A 12-week MAP with a 2-week eval sprint, followed by a staged ramp to a 24-GPU pool (H100-equivalent) for production.
- Clear lead times for procurement / private deployment (network + KMS) so we can align procurement windows with our Q3 budget cycle.
- An initial cost estimate and fallback/hedge plan if lead times slip.

Can you share a draft MAP and a proposed timeline that includes: evaluation milestones, acceptance criteria, and expected handover dates for provisioning? We have Legal in copy once we hit commitment.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Platform Engineering
Edge Health

Attachments: evaluation-prompt-set.md (text)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.r@edgehealth.ai>, Edge Health Legal <contracts@edgehealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & eval cadence for Edge Health reserve plan

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear asks and for sharing the prompt set. I put together a first-pass MAP and proposed reserve timeline attached (EdgeHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx). Key highlights up front: 

- MAP duration: 12 weeks (2-week eval -> 6-week staged onramp -> 4-week acceptance + post-cutover buffer).
- Target pool: 24x A100/H100-equivalent GPUs (we'll provide exact SKU options; you can opt for a mixed H100 staging pool to accelerate eval).
- Lead times: Private setup (VPC + KMS onboarding) typically 3–5 weeks; dedicated hardware reservation depends on tranches — earliest available capacity window is ~8–12 weeks from PO if we commit to a dedicated tranche now.

Action items I propose: 
1) Internal sizing call (30m) to align on inference concurrency and sequence lengths — helps finalize GPU count. Ben / Priyom, can you join?
2) We’ll drop a MAP workbook with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria (attached).
3) If Edge signs a tranche commitment by 2026-06-25, we can target POC staging in week-of 2026-08-17 and production cutover late Sep.

Sofia — legal / procurement notes are welcome; I flagged the DocuSign path in the MAP workbook for expedited signing.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: EdgeHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & eval cadence for Edge Health reserve plan

Dylan / Priyom — quick internal sync notes after reviewing the MAP: 

- Sizing assumption check: Sofia mentioned a 24-GPU target. We'll validate with the infra sizing call, but for planning we should prepare two SKU scenarios: (A) 24x 80GB H100-equivalent; (B) 32x 40GB A100 mix (lower cost, slightly lower throughput). I lean to recommending H100 for latency-sensitive clinical inferences.
- Lead-time mitigation: offer a staggered tranche (8 GPU immediate + 16 GPU in 6 weeks) to reduce exposure and get them into staging earlier. That buys us time for procurement and KMS network validation.
- Acceptance criteria: need an explicit latency p50/p95 target and a token-throughput baseline from Edge’s eval prompt set. Put the acceptance template in the MAP (owner: Priyom).

Priyom — can you draft the acceptance checklist and a short fallback playbook (if hardware delays) by EOD Wed? Irene, I’ll need your sign-off on the tranche pricing/credits for the staggered option.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.r@edgehealth.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Edge Health Legal <contracts@edgehealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & eval cadence for Edge Health reserve plan

Thanks all — this looks actionable and reasonable. A few quick confirms from our side: 

- We’re comfortable with the staggered tranche approach (8 + 16) if the pricing delta and credit terms look favorable.
- Our acceptance criteria: p50 <= 50ms, p95 <= 120ms on the evaluation prompt set (2k tokens median prompt), and <2% quality degradation versus our current baseline. Priyom — happy to share sample telemetry for the first sizing call.
- Legal is fine to kick off DocuSign once you drop final pricing and lead-time language (contracts@edgehealth.ai is on copy).

Next step: please confirm a few time slots for the sizing call next week (30 minutes). We prefer mornings PT.

Sofia
Head of Platform Engineering, Edge Health
